content:
Noelle (CS): Quick flag  Seedling beta cohort is at 19 signups; our live capacity is 16. Want to avoid auto-waitlist for expansion accounts. Signup sheet: https://tiny.redwood/seedling-signups
Jun (AE): Which accounts should we protect? I have two at risk if onboarding slips.
Noelle (CS): Marked priority: EmberLane (expansion + contract in 6w), Quoin (security review), KiteWorks (custom connector). Added tags in the sheet.
Rae (PM): Can we offer a hybrid flow: 40m core live + 20m recorded deep-dive for integrations? That should free seats. Also we need the micro-survey to include cohort=seedling_may and enablement_path=hybrid|live|recorded. Template: https://tiny.redwood/micro-seed
Ibrahim (SE): I can run the integration deep-dive for KiteWorks on Thurs 2pm if invited. Need their sample payloads beforehand.
Mira (Analytics): If we set "followup_needed" when satisfaction<=2, we can auto-create a task in CS ops. I'll wire the webhook once Rae confirms payload fields.
Seedling-bot: Reminder: cohort_size >16 will trigger waitlist automation unless tagged high_priority. Current cohort=19. Suggest tagging high_priority for EmberLane & Quoin.
Jun (AE): EmberLane confirmed hybrid is fine. Quoin insists on live due to security questions. I'll ask KiteWorks if recorded+office hour is acceptable.
Noelle (CS): Action list: [Jun] confirm KiteWorks preference (pending), [Ibrahim] reserve Thurs 2pm for KiteWorks deep-dive (assigned), [Rae] add cohort tags to survey (pending), [Mira] add webhook for followups (pending).
Ibrahim (SE): Reserved Thurs 2pm and added an integration checklist to the invite. @Noelle can you request sample payloads in the invite body?
Noelle (CS): Done  asked KiteWorks for payloads and S3 link. If no reply in 24h we'll run discovery-first and use generic examples.
Rae (PM): Survey fields added: cohort_id=seedling_may, enablement_path, free_text_top_blocker. followup_needed boolean = score<=2. Mira, will that format work for analytics?
Mira (Analytics): Yes  will pick up cohort_id and enablement_path. I'll also emit a cross-tab for time-to-first-success by path next week.
Jun (AE): KiteWorks prefers recorded + office hour  frees 1 live seat. That gets us under auto-waitlist for now.
Noelle (CS): Great  converting two attendees to recorded+office hours cleared the waitlist trigger. I'll post a short recap tomorrow AM and move EmberLane into high_touch in CRM. Thanks all :raised_hands:
